header: Total cost of ownership in figures
subheader: Licence, hosting, hours and migration over a set period
lead: Each figure has a unit and a line on what it is measured against. Without a stated basis, a cost comparison proves nothing.
note: The note states the basis of the comparison: the period, the size of the organisation and the date of the prices.

figures.title: The label names the figure
figures.text: It is a description list, so each label stays paired with its figure.

figures.title: The unit is text, not styling
figures.text: So screen readers announce the unit, not just the number.

figures.title: The basis is the third line
figures.text: Where the number came from, and what it excludes.

figures.title: Two to eight figures
figures.text: Fewer than two is not a comparison. More than eight needs a table.
